notes.title: Update of the first chapter. Chapter completed.
notes.content:
We are the Grebot Games team, and have recently completed a major demo and chapter 1 update for our novel Cold Harvest.

For everyone who has already completed the previously released version, we recommend that you go through the first chapter again, as the changes affected the plot, new scenes were added and a lot of work was done on the bugs. Unfortunately, saves from the old version of the game cannot be used in the current version.

In the future, such changes are not planned for the first chapter and the demo, as we have made all the planned changes and are now actively engaged in the creation of the second and subsequent chapters. But still, since the project is in early access and is actively developed, adjustments and bugs are possible until the release of the game.

We thank everyone who has already played and actively participates in the development of the project.
